description: Defines the 'Capabilities' static class in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, including nested enums and classes for feature availability, backward compatibility, and rendering options related to PDF and RTF generation.
external_files: LICENSE file in the solution root

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: A static class providing configuration and feature support information for PDFsharp/MigraDoc, including feature availability actions and backward compatibility settings.

methods.name: Capabilities.FeatureNotAvailableAction
methods.description: An enum defining actions to take when a requested feature is not available in the current build.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility
methods.description: A static class providing backward compatibility flags and settings for MigraDoc.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility.TreatArgbZeroAsEmptyColor
methods.description: Flag indicating how Color(0) is interpreted, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility.DoNotCreateLastParagraph
methods.description: Flag indicating whether to prevent creation of the last paragraph.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility.DoNotCreateLastTable
methods.description: Flag indicating whether to prevent creation of the last table.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility.DoNotCreateLastSection
methods.description: Flag indicating whether to prevent creation of the last section if none exists.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility.DoNotUnifyTabStopHandling
methods.description: Flag to reactivate old behavior for tabstop handling in RTF.

methods.name: Capabilities.Compatibility
methods.description: A static class for compatibility settings related to rendering charts and other features.

methods.name: Capabilities.Compatibility.ChartsCannotBeRendered
methods.description: Flag indicating if unsupported charts should be silently ignored or cause exceptions.
